title: Certificates of Deposit: Which Penalty Entry Is Tested Against the Term's Rate and Penalty Days
content:
When an early withdrawal penalty on one of the bank's Certificates of Deposit is tested against the rate and penalty days that the certificate terms set for a term, the test is run on one identified ledger entry. This page fixes which entry that is and which entries stand outside the test.

## The entry tested

- The entry tested is the certificate's latest penalty entry, meaning the penalty entry with the most recent posting date.
- Every figure the test uses comes from that one entry: its booked sum, the rate shown as applied, the number of penalty days shown, and its posting date. Figures are never mixed from different penalty entries.
- An older penalty entry is tested this way only for as long as it remains the certificate's latest penalty. Once a newer penalty has posted, the older one is dealt with under the general grounds for reversing penalties, not here.

## Entries outside the test

| Entry | Why it stands outside |
|---|---|
| A penalty posted before the start date of the certificate's current term | The rate rebuilt for the test is the rate of the current term, so only a penalty posted on or after the current term start date is tested; an earlier-term penalty falls under the general reversal grounds. |
| A penalty posted on any day from the first to the last grace day, counting the day after the certificate's maturity date as the first | It belongs to a withdrawal taken in the grace period and is handled under the rules on penalties charged on grace-period withdrawals. |
| A penalty that already has a reversal entry pointing to it | A penalty is never credited back twice. |

## Input, judgement, outcome (hypothetical records; grace period of ten days assumed)

| Latest penalty entry posted | Current term start date | Maturity date | Reversal already on it? | Tested here? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 April 2026 | 2 January 2026 | 2 July 2027 | No | Yes |
| 20 December 2025 | 2 January 2026 | 2 July 2027 | No | No, an earlier term |
| 7 July 2027 | 2 January 2026 | 2 July 2027 | No | No, day 5 of grace |
| 14 April 2026 | 2 January 2026 | 2 July 2027 | Yes | No, already reversed |

## Point of judgement

**The certificate carries two penalty entries from the current term.** Only the later one is tested here; the earlier is left to the general reversal grounds.
